\chapter{Village and Shop Complete Ten}
\label{ch:gu-village-shop-ten}
\hlchaptermodality{27}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can hear, say, read, and write ten concrete Gujarati words, including village and shop.}

Village and shop enter meaning-first, then mix with the prior eight words before a non-compensatory four-skill payoff.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[gām]{\gu{ગામ} — hear village first}

\label{lesson:GU-C23-hear-gaam}



\begin{quote}
Recall \emph{shahar}, city. Now listen twice: \textbf{gām}. It means \textbf{village}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Choose city or village as you hear \emph{shahar} or \emph{gām}, then say \emph{gām} once.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-gujarati/village}{Cambridge: village}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[gām]{\gu{ગામ} — village on the page}

\label{lesson:GU-C23-gaam}



\begin{quote}
Say \emph{gām} from \textbf{village}, then look: \textbf{\gu{ગામ}} — \emph{gām} — village.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Study \textbf{\gu{ગામ}} for five seconds, hide it, and write it once. Check only after the word is complete.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-gujarati/village}{Cambridge: village}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[dukān]{\gu{દુકાન} — hear shop first}

\label{lesson:GU-C23-hear-dukaan}



\begin{quote}
Listen twice: \textbf{dukān}. It means \textbf{shop}. Hear the short \emph{u} before the long final \emph{ā}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Point to the shop when you hear \emph{dukān}, then say \emph{dukān} from the meaning.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Source: \href{https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-gujarati/shop}{Cambridge: shop}.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[dukān]{\gu{દુકાન} — shop on the page}

\label{lesson:GU-C23-dukaan}



\begin{quote}
Say \emph{dukān} from \textbf{shop}, then look: \textbf{\gu{દુકાન}} — \emph{dukān} — shop.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Copy \textbf{\gu{દુકાન}} once. Point to the \textbf{\gu{ુ}} under \textbf{\gu{દ}}, then read the complete word.
